prompt: [intrigued, quick, pointing it out] If you connect 200,000 living human brain cells to Doom, they can help make the character shoot. [slightly amazed] Scientists actually did it. [energized, clear] The game sends electrical signals into them, and when the neurons fire back, software translates their activity into commands to move, turn, and shoot. [dry, a little amused] They're terrible at the game, and a normal computer still does much of the work. [leaning in] But the weirdest part is real. [quietly amazed] This video game controller is ALIVE.
